import base64, hashlib, io, json, subprocess, zipfile
from pathlib import Path

staging = Path('products/distribution/sqlite-instructor-pilot/placement')
site = Path('products/sites/sqlite-statement-diagnostic')
index = site / 'index.html'
payload = site / 'sqlite-preview.zip.b64'

def digest(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

expected_baseline = '1dbcaa64a3f399c03612ce1c999e342fc901727ed4889bfee83a0afc7bcd78db'
expected_candidate = 'ef9f8dc368fa7485bd23d2f7cb91d11381e31af3d3bea58d8c75d68b7ce3adad'
expected_archive = '8325a93711826740de4fffb9d43a312b048b26a43212280fd53df55fb5c11eb2'
current = index.read_bytes()
current_hash = digest(current)
print('Current site index SHA-256:', current_hash, flush=True)
if current_hash == expected_baseline:
    candidate = subprocess.run(['patch', '--batch', '--forward', '--fuzz=0', '--output=-', str(index)], input=(staging / 'index.diff').read_bytes(), stdout=subprocess.PIPE, check=True).stdout
elif current_hash == expected_candidate:
    candidate = current
else:
    raise SystemExit('Site candidate differs from the captured baseline and the tested revision. Reconcile the site changes before applying the preview patch.')
assert digest(candidate) == expected_candidate, 'Patched index differs from the tested revision'
assert b'href="sqlite-preview.zip"' in candidate or b"href='sqlite-preview.zip'" in candidate, 'Relative ZIP link missing'
encoded = (staging / 'sqlite-preview.zip.b64').read_bytes()
archive = base64.b64decode(b''.join(encoded.split()), validate=True)
assert digest(archive) == expected_archive, 'Preview archive hash mismatch'
with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(archive)) as bundle:
    assert sorted(bundle.namelist()) == ['README.md', 'after.sql', 'before.sql', 'run.py', 'seed.sql']
    assert bundle.testzip() is None
assert not (site / 'sqlite-preview.zip').exists(), 'Raw ZIP target already exists'
if payload.exists():
    assert payload.read_bytes() == encoded, 'Existing encoded ZIP differs'
index.write_bytes(candidate)
payload.write_bytes(encoded)
print(json.dumps({'prior_index_sha256': current_hash, 'staged_index_sha256': digest(index.read_bytes()), 'decoded_zip_sha256': digest(base64.b64decode(b''.join(payload.read_bytes().split()), validate=True)), 'download_target': 'sqlite-preview.zip', 'public_deployment': 'pending exact-digest independent review'}))
